vectors.description: selected matches the effective ids in selection order: another order fails, and what was given is listed
output matches when the output has the expected keys with equal values, the others unchecked; null expects no rule selected; {} expects one
a decision with no single output matches no output, null included: the key fails with its reason and no actual

vectors.description: under collect with an aggregate, output is the aggregate, null when nothing is selected; outputs are the selected rules' own
outputs matches item by item, each as an output; a different count fails, and what was given has every key
unknown matches the effective ids of the rules whose condition is unknown, as a set; given sorted by code point
a failure lists every key that does not match, in the order of the expectations table, whatever their order in the file
expected values match by canonical bytes: an int is not a float, decimals keep their scale, floats their sign of zero, and nulls match whatever their reason
